notes.title: Aria: Dragon Eater has been Released!
notes.notes:
Hello Wizards,

We happily announce the release of a new game Aria: Dragon Eater!
We hope you enjoy this game.

Thank you!

1st patch:
Fixed the issue in which the player's Fireball was intermittently disabled.
Trimmed levels design.
Trimmed dialogues.
Trim cutscene images.
